title: Diseñador de tuberías frigoríficas

output_contract.lines: Commercial OD, calculated ID, velocity at minimum and maximum capacity, friction and static pressure drop and equivalent saturation loss.
output_contract.oil_management: Required lower traps, intermediate traps, double riser proposal and manufacturer checks.

output_contract.bill_of_quantities: Neutral quantities prepared for the future private cost engine; no public unit prices.

priority_rule: A documented manufacturer limit or line-size table overrides the generic engineering proposal.
